replies.author: @target844
replies.text:
The island of Kataja it also shared between Sweden and Finland with a 400m long border. It is just south of Haparanda, and the border is the easternmost point of Sweden.  Between it and the mainland, there is two additional shared islands Tirro (249 meter border)  and Leppikari (100 meter border).

There are land borders in Haparanda and Tornio to in the cities; Tornio is on the western side of the river.  There is a 350-meter-long land border where most of it is made up of Victoriatorget (Victoria Square), just beside it is a mall in Finland. Add to that around 500 meters of land border north of Tornio city, which is a golf course 

It adds up to around 1600 meters of land border between Sweden and Finland around Haparanda.  It is an approximate lenght because I measured them all on Google Maps. Some parts are marshland or areas with reeds. What is land is not obvious from aerial photographs
